assignments.question: R01: Which exact IDs and state changed after rejected update? R02: Did invalid batch emit a row, and was help redirected to a failing destination?
assignments.purpose: Separate store mutation, executable behavior and output failure.
assignments.scope: Core store and CLI consumers; source revision and targeted fixtures only.
assignments.deliverable: Paths Store::update/validate -> CLI Store/add/snapshot -> stdout, tests core.store and core.cli, unknown IDs, input, invocation, redirected destination and config; propose matched discriminators and limitations.
assignments.stop_condition: Evidence sufficient to distinguish the reported outcomes or identify missing input.
assignments.model_reason: Independent bounded contract and caller investigation.
expected_work_operations: Compare full ID/text snapshots before and after the same valid versus rejected update including absent ID; inspect core.store coverage.

Compare valid-first plus invalid-second batch with valid batch, capture stdout/stderr/status; compare help to ordinary file and failing output device where available; core.cli covers system-fixture/dev/full only where available.

assignments.question: R03: Is the alleged package actually linked to the Rust provider, and does the same byte input differ through the real C++ caller?
assignments.purpose: Distinguish package/configuration identity from provider or caller defect.
assignments.scope: Provider, ABI, store and actual package consumer/selection paths.
assignments.deliverable: Trace provider marker -> ABI validate -> C++ bridge -> Store/CLI consumer and configured/imported path; named core.text_validation and core.text_status fixtures, their limits, and exact identity/byte comparison plan.
assignments.stop_condition: Provider identity and matched-input discriminator specified, or missing package/configuration identified.
expected_work_operations: Inspect provider marker and caller; compare identical non-ASCII bytes and valid control with provider/package/library markers and status through actual C++ caller.
Review SDK path fixture only for relevance to selected package; status substitution does not establish linked provider.

assignments.question: R04 and R05: Where do adapter events, shared state, rendering and native generation updates diverge?
assignments.purpose: Separate event normalization/state/presentation and stale producer/consumer paths.
assignments.scope: Shared application and native executor with affected adapters.
assignments.deliverable: Trace Application::handle/append_entry -> status/list snapshot -> adapter and task start/cancel/advance -> UI; identify GUI application/native fixtures and adapter, generation and event-order gaps.
assignments.stop_condition: Matched sequence and generation trace proposed, or adapter/order prerequisite missing.
assignments.model_reason: Distinct GUI/state and worker lifecycle investigation.
expected_work_operations: Compare identical edit/submit events and snapshots via affected and reference adapters, recording normalized events, authoritative list/status and rendered view.

Gate start/cancel/start and capture generation at production, mailbox and application consumption; compare current/stale updates using native task fixture; distinguish deterministic fixture from real scheduling.

assignments.question: R06 and R07: Does polling resume after failure and does wheel behavior depend on overflow or focus?
assignments.purpose: Distinguish transport lifecycle from GUI interaction/retained-input selection.
assignments.scope: Browser lifecycle, text/wheel interaction, and selected GUI source-group consumer.
assignments.deliverable: Trace startPolling -> client send/failed -> host/view, text frame -> wheel propagation -> containing pane, and GuiInputs -> selected retained source; identify registered lifecycle and text/wheel fixtures and their limits.
assignments.stop_condition: Proposed controlled failure/recovery and overflow comparison with consumer paths and dependencies.
assignments.model_reason: Independent bounded transport and input investigation.
expected_work_operations: Use same fake scheduler/client with success, rejection and failed-to-recovered transitions; log timers, sends and state; fixture cannot prove behavior in all browsers.
Compare identical wheel and focus events with child overflow versus none, recording child/parent offsets and focus; check patch and selected input identity without changing retained kernel.

assignments.question: R08: Does the model-to-view mapping explain displacement, and does flow truncate at producer, edge or consumer?
assignments.purpose: Separate two editor symptoms rather than assume common cause.
assignments.deliverable: Trace project value -> canvas render/model_to_view -> hit/paint consumer; flow WorkResult -> publish/consume -> sink, with editor.canvas_test, editor.model_test and editor.flow_test registration and limits.
assignments.stop_condition: Known project/mode needed or matched checks and source gaps documented.
assignments.model_reason: Luna can trace independent, bounded value and flow evidence.
expected_work_operations: Compare same model point before/after one value with fixed viewport/pan/zoom, then transform round-trip, object bounds and paint/hit result.
Use same graph/data in reported and control modes, compare produced/consumed counts, terminal snapshot and exact sink sequence; flow test samples and its modes do not establish all consumers.

assignments.question: Which selected build or retained-input consumer, prerequisites, registrations and wrapper constraints materially limit the eight discriminators?
assignments.purpose: Cover build/retained-input layer and prevent setup errors masquerading as regressions.
assignments.scope: Only selected relevant configuration, consumer and execution-integrity paths; no broad inventory.
assignments.deliverable: Source references from GuiInputs/source_group through GUI configuration, fixture test_gui_source_group and applicable registered helper suites; explicit selection, readiness, process and capacity limitations.
assignments.stop_condition: Identity and prerequisite checks mapped; stop if unrelated helper branches add no relevant signal.
assignments.model_reason: Useful neighboring consumer and execution-integrity discovery.
expected_work_operations: Check selected source/group and manifest identity against actual consumer; inspect path containment, process cleanup and capacity helpers only insofar as planned operations depend on them.
Record targeted test enablement, wrapper and prerequisite needs; do not configure or run anything in this study.

assignments.question: What report details are missing and what evidence would discriminate initial hypotheses?
assignments.purpose: Make early requests while independent source work proceeds.
assignments.scope: All eight symptom reports and campaign coordination.
assignments.deliverable: Request IDs and input/config/version; CLI args and redirect destination; provider/package marker and bytes; adapter/events; task generations/timing; browser/transport log; overflow/focus; project/mode and full expected/actual output. Track unanswered fields explicitly.
assignments.stop_condition: Requests issued as a single concise bundle, uncertainty logged; no waiting for optional replies.
assignments.model_reason: Coordinator owns scope and user communication.
expected_work_operations: Prioritize material objective and tradeoff clarification, then compare report identity with source and eventual trace.

assignments.question: Are source identity, evidence support, relevance, coverage and conflicts sufficient for a decision?
assignments.purpose: Screen findings without replacing expert judgment.
assignments.scope: All returned evidence and acceptance rubric.
assignments.deliverable: Eight-row classification with symptoms/unknowns, entry and consumer, fixture limits, discriminator, status and links; source revision, gaps, alternatives, dissent and compact handoff.
assignments.stop_condition: Each finding screened when available; return separable factual gaps to available Luna; stop low-value redundant searches.
assignments.model_reason: Ordinary evidence screening, not architecture approval.
expected_work_operations: Check source/revision and support, duplicated claims and contradictions; maintain direct expert source access.
Record unreproduced versus rejected hypothesis versus setup failure versus untested, never infer a pass from registration.

assignments.question: Does any proposed architectural, algorithmic or measurement-contract decision retain the original objective and discriminate alternatives?
assignments.purpose: Authorize consequential design before dependent implementation.
assignments.scope: Consequential judgments and independent patch review; direct source access.
assignments.deliverable: Decision with requirements, alternatives, decisive sources, unresolved dissent and explicit approval or redesign; independently review any eventual patch and preserved original failure.
dependencies: Trigger: consequential decision, patch ready, or exhausted repair; do not wait on P08 when decision is ready
assignments.stop_condition: Decision reviewed or blocker identified; return factual gaps to Luna.
assignments.model_reason: Strong independent judgment for consequential design and acceptance.
expected_work_operations: Review causal discriminators and assumptions; challenge supported alternatives and unchanged correctness thresholds.

assignments.question: Is there a simpler strategic approach or hidden wrong turn where conflicting evidence or expensive uncertainty makes it valuable?
assignments.scope: Bounded read-only strategic uncertainty, not duplicate review.
assignments.deliverable: Compact alternatives, decisive evidence, unresolved questions, stop/redesign recommendation.
dependencies: Trigger: strategic uncertainty, contradicted assumptions, costly wrong turn or diminishing returns
assignments.stop_condition: Decision-ready advice or precise missing evidence.
assignments.model_reason: Strategic challenge when material; an authorized review also satisfies the consequential model gate.
expected_work_operations: Review original requirements and competing causal/measurement approaches with direct access to sources; avoid waiting for mandatory screening.

assignments.question: Can a focused existing fixture reproduce and separate a particular symptom under matched identity and configuration?
assignments.purpose: Establish causal evidence once a future campaign is separately authorized.
assignments.scope: Only independently authorized targeted operations and assigned fixture; no package release, kernel work or broad matrices.
assignments.deliverable: Preserved exact inputs, revision, build/provider/adapter markers, stdout/stderr, exit status, trace and classified result with coverage limits.
assignments.ownership: Exclusive hypothetical fixture/output paths per worker; shared tree writer serialized.
assignments.stop_condition: Discriminator answered, prerequisite missing or allocated horizon reached.
assignments.model_reason: Focused settled execution is suitable bounded work.
expected_work_operations: Follow project build wrapper if necessary; serialize shared build writes; treat absent enabled target or provider as setup failure.
Compare matched control and reported case; retain failing input and logs, do not weaken assertions.

assignments.question: Can one evidence-backed local repair resolve a reproduced narrowly owned defect without changing contract?
assignments.purpose: Repair only after authorized reproduction, causality and design review.
assignments.scope: One bounded defect and exclusively assigned hypothetical files.
assignments.deliverable: Patch plus unchanged original failing regression, targeted results and ownership handoff for independent review.
assignments.ownership: Only explicitly assigned hypothetical files; no overlapping writes.
assignments.stop_condition: One repair attempt and targeted verification; escalate exhausted repair or scope change to Sol.
assignments.model_reason: Settled local repair with explicit causal evidence and bounded ownership.
expected_work_operations: Preserve original failure and all thresholds, run focused existing checks under resource controls; request independent patch review.

concurrency: First wave: Terra coordinator plus four Luna conversations P01-P04 = five active reasoning slots; leave one available for immediate Sol or Astra when triggered. On completion reuse core for P05 and provider for P06; experts occupy the reserved slot and other waves are queued if necessary. Up to four test processes only after separate authorization; cap aggregate at 8 CPU / 16 GiB, reserve headroom, serialize all shared build writers and nested output writers, and defer checks that cannot fit. No process is launched in this study. Two-hour horizon remains fixed across reassignment.
reuse: Reuse core, provider, gui-native and gui-web contexts for related bounded tasks, never duplicate discovery. Terra screens results incrementally and hands experts compact requirements, decisive source pointers, competing explanations and dissent; original evidence remains accessible. P11/P12 reuse an idle appropriate worker with explicit file ownership; review is independent of patch author.

expert_and_human_triggers.sol: Review every consequential architecture/algorithm/measurement-contract choice before substantial dependent work, any independent patch before acceptance, and own escalations for exhausted repair or consequential scope change. Do not wait for scouting/screening when the decision is ready.
expert_and_human_triggers.astra: Consult promptly for strategic uncertainty, contradictions, expensive wrong turns or diminishing returns; may independently satisfy a consequential decision review when authorized.
expert_and_human_triggers.human: Ask early for material missing objective/tradeoff and report details, configuration, source/trace identity and reproduction input; independent source work proceeds while optional responses are pending. Silence does not authorize execution, configuration, wider scope or changes. Escalate unavailable prerequisites and unresolved consequential tradeoffs.

rejected_research: Do not infer a common cause from the symptom cluster or report source registrations as passes.
No full regression, broad platform/backend matrix, release qualification, publication, history mining or retained kernel configure/compile/link/install; none is required for these focused questions.
Do not pursue all helper units as incidents or execute speculative fixes or unrelated literature searches; redirect factual branches with low relevance or duplicate evidence.
assumptions_and_uncertainties: The given source revision and clean-tree report are packet assertions, not independently verified. All eight reports are hypothetical and unreproduced; no source unit establishes a test execution or complete inventory.

Build tree ready and resource envelope are hypothetical campaign assumptions; unavailable target/provider/configuration is setup failure, not regression. Additional operations require separate authorization.
R11 identifies a retained-input/build consumer path; its test fixture and configuration checks do not prove behavior of every retained source or authorize retained kernel operations.
No comparable prior eligible Luna baseline is supplied; no claim that a numerical allocation preference has been achieved.
